stories.title: Ben Shelton's shot at history comes Sunday in the US Open final
stories.summary: Can Shelton become the first American man in 23 years to win a major? He'll carry the ultimate home-court pressure into his showdown with Zverev.

stories.title: 'Let's do it for the USA': Shelton looks to end wait in US Open final vs. Zverev
stories.summary: Ben Shelton won the all-American duel with Frances Tiafoe and will play No. 1 seed Alexander Zverev on Sunday for the US Open title.

stories.title: Jeter reunites with 9/11 victim's daughter as Yanks pay tribute in ceremony
stories.summary: Derek Jeter was among the members of the 2001 Yankees on hand to honor 9/11 victims Friday night in a pregame ceremony, which concluded with first pitches from Brielle Saracini and Sean McGuire, a married couple whose fathers died on Sept. 11, 2001.

stories.title: BC honors Crowther on 25th anniversary of 9/11 with annual Red Bandanna Game
stories.summary: On the 25th anniversary of 9/11, Boston College hosted Rutgers in its annual Red Bandanna Game on Friday night. It had special meaning for both schools.

stories.title: Rays 1st into playoffs after Caminero's walk-off HR
stories.summary: The Rays became the first major league team to secure a postseason spot, beating the Houston Astros 3-1 on Friday night on Junior Caminero's game-ending, two-run homer.
